messages:
Maria (Customer): Hey support — our compliance team lost access to audit logs after our SSO migration. Console shows 403 with error 'entitlement.audit.read: denied'. This was working pre-migration. Org: org_9a7b, user: maria@acme.example. Ticket CS-8721. Any quick checks?

Alex (Support): Sorry about that, Maria. Can you confirm whether affected users are mapped to any SCIM groups post-migration, and whether you changed the SAML attribute mapping recently? Also can you paste the exact console error or a curl repro if you have it?

Maria (Customer): Repro steps are simple: SSO login -> Console -> Compliance -> Audit logs -> 403. Here's the API repro we used: 
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"X-Org-ID: org_9a7b\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/logs
# Response:
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"entitlement.audit.read","message":"missing entitlement"}
```

Alex (Support): Thanks. That error usually means the user's session token doesn't carry the audit_read entitlement OR the org-level retention/view flag is off. Two things to check: (1) SAML/SCIM mapping for the 'Compliance-Audit-Readers' group, (2) org entitlements via admin API.

Sam (SRE): Quick note — we've seen a pattern where Okta's SAML attribute name changed during a migration (old attr `entitlements`, new `appEntitlements`) so the connector stopped populating the audit role. If the SCIM group wasn't re-provisioned, tokens won't get the entitlement.

Jordan (AuthEng): @Alex / @Sam: also flagging that there's an entitlement split now: `audit.read` (ability to query live logs) and `audit.retention_view` (ability to see retained/archived logs beyond X days). Org-level retention_view must be true for users to see older records. Migration scripts sometimes forget to copy org entitlements.

Alex (Support): Maria, can you ask a scoped admin to run this quick check (no creds shared):
```
GET /v1/orgs/org_9a7b/entitlements
# Expect a JSON response that includes: 
# "audit_read": true, "audit_retention_view": true
```
If either is false, that explains the 403.

Maria (Customer): I asked our admin; they ran the admin console and pasted back: `{"audit_read": false, "audit_retention_view": false}`. Looks like both are false now. We never changed these intentionally.

Jordan (AuthEng): OK — root cause likely migration reset. Two remediation options: (A) fix SAML/SCIM mapping so coming sessions carry entitlement again, or (B) grant the org flags temporarily via admin API while you fix mapping. If you want, we can apply a temporary grant for a short window for compliance to investigate.

Alex (Support): If you want the quick temporary unblock, we can escalate to Ops to apply a scoped entitlement change. It requires a short maintenance window for auditing. Jordan, can you sign off?

Jordan (AuthEng): Signed — good to do. Also recommend capturing a SAML assertion from an affected user and check attributes — if `appEntitlements` contains `audit:read` then SCIM mapping is fine; otherwise mapping needs update.

Ops Oncall: Running the org entitlement patch now for org_9a7b, granting `audit_read` + `audit_retention_view` for 2 hours, will log action.

AuditBot: [audit] org org_9a7b entitlements.update by Ops Oncall (temp_grant) at 2026-03-17T15:12:03Z

Ops Oncall: Done — patch returned 200. Sample call we used: 
```
PATCH /v1/orgs/org_9a7b/entitlements
{"audit_read": true, "audit_retention_view": true, "note": "temp grant for CS-8721"}
```

Maria (Customer): Confirmed — compliance team can now see the audit logs and run queries. Thanks, everyone! :tada:

Alex (Support): Great. Next steps for you (recommended):
- Keep the temp grant only as a short-term measure.
- Provide us a SAML assertion sample (or let us pull one) so AuthEng can validate attribute mapping.
- Re-provision the SCIM group or update SAML attribute mapping to include `audit:read` or map `appEntitlements` -> Redwood entitlement claim.
- Once mapping is fixed, we can revoke the temporary org flag.

Jordan (AuthEng): I'll open an internal ticket to update our docs and add a migration checklist item to verify org entitlements after SSO migrations (referencing CS-8721).

Maria (Customer): Appreciate the fast turnaround. Please keep me posted when you update the docs so we can avoid this in future migrations.

Alex (Support): Will do — assigning follow-up to AuthEng and Support docs. :thumbsup:
